description: React component implementing an interactive D3 force-directed graph for a career pathway navigator, including data fetching, graph rendering, node interaction, and roadmap saving.

methods.name: normalizeProgress
methods.description: Normalizes progress status strings to standardized values ('completed', 'in_progress', 'not_started').

methods.name: nodeProgress
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes the progress of a node based on its ID and progress mapping.

methods.name: isSkill
methods.description: Checks if a node is of type 'skill'.

methods.name: effectiveNodeIsGap
methods.description: Determines if a node is considered a gap based on its properties and progress.

methods.name: nodeFillColor
methods.description: Returns the fill color for a node based on its type and progress.

methods.name: effectiveLinkIsGap
methods.description: Determines if a link is considered a gap based on its properties and connected nodes.

methods.name: Graph
methods.description: Main React component rendering an interactive graph with data fetching, state management, and D3 visualization.

methods.name: onNodeClick
methods.description: Handles node click events to load and display detailed information.

methods.name: saveRoadmap
methods.description: Saves the current graph as a roadmap via API call, including data sanitization.

methods.name: onResetZoom
methods.description: Resets the zoom level of the SVG graph.
